SELECT examStudentPaperAnswer.* , examStudent.real_name AS realName , examPaper.paper_name AS paperName , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle , examQuestion.standard_answer AS standardAnswer FROM exam_student_paper_answer examStudentPaperAnswer LEFT JOIN exam_student examStudent ON examStudentPaperAnswer.student_id = examStudent.id LEFT JOIN exam_paper examPaper ON examStudentPaperAnswer.paper_id = examPaper.id LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examStudentPaperAnswer.question_id = examQuestion.id
ORDER BY examStudentPaperAnswer.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
